# Zone 1: Siberia & Subpolar Permafrost Friction
oe_col2_eco_siberia_frost = {
	type = location
	category = location

	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		current_year < 1620
		OR = {
			region = region:west_siberia_region
			region = region:east_siberia_region
			region = region:ural_region
		}
		OR = {
			climate = arctic
			climate = subpolar
		}
		NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_col2_cossack_ostrog }
		NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_col2_cossack_ostrog_mod }
		NOT = { owner = { oe_col2_has_surveyor_bypass = yes } }
		NOT = { owner = { oe_col2_is_cossack_frontier_power = yes } }
	}

	local_migration_attraction = -0.35
	local_supply_limit_modifier = -0.30
	local_population_growth = -0.001
}

# Zone 2: Saharan & Interior Arid Supply Drag
oe_col2_eco_sahara_aridity = {
	type = location
	category = location

	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		current_year < 1650
		is_coastal = no
		OR = {
			region = region:sahel_region
			region = region:maghreb_region
			region = region:egypt_region
			region = region:arabia_region
		}
		OR = {
			climate = arid
			vegetation = desert
		}
		local_control < 0.40
		NOT = { owner = { oe_col2_has_surveyor_bypass = yes } }

			exists = capital

				capital.continent = continent:africa
				capital.region = region:arabia_region

				capital.region = region:persia_region

		}
	}

}
